messages:
zoe: quick Q — a user reported an error and gave me request_id=req_9f4b2e and trace_id=4d3a7c. What's the fastest way to pull all logs + spans for that in Console and via CLI?

matt: Console: Observability -> Logs, then search for request_id:\"req_9f4b2e\". For traces go to Observability -> Traces and paste trace_id 4d3a7c.

matt: CLI quick commands (use rcli from dev box):
```
# get logs for a request id
rcli logs get --request-id req_9f4b2e

# fetch trace (json)
rcli trace get 4d3a7c --output json
```

matt: If you want tailing while repro-ing, rcli logs tail --request-id req_9f4b2e or `rcli traces follow 4d3a7c` (streams spans).

jess: small gotcha — traces are sampled. If you can't find the trace, search logs by request_id or the X-Request-ID header value. In Console you can also use the Logs Explorer query: `request_id:\"req_9f4b2e\" or headers.request_id:\"req_9f4b2e\"`.

jess: helpful Console links (copy-paste):
https://console.redwood.ai/observability/logs?q=request_id%3Areq_9f4b2e
https://console.redwood.ai/observability/traces?q=trace_id%3A4d3a7c

zoe: thanks! if the trace is sampled out, any way to map trace->request_id?

matt: yes — spans include the request_id tag in our instrumentation most of the time. If you have span ids, open the trace and inspect span tags. Otherwise use Logs Explorer for the request_id which is logged at request start and end.

infra-bot: NOTE: If you need a full export for long-term retention, submit `infra export-logs --request-id req_9f4b2e` or ping #support-exports.

zoe: trying the CLI now. one more — where is the prod rcli config?

matt: prod profile is `rcli config use-profile prod`. creds are via vault role `infra/rcli/prod`. If you don't have access, @jess can grant it.

jess: granted zoe (you should be able to run the two commands above). :thumbsup:

zoe: got the logs and the trace — found the 500 at service-x span, sending repro + span dump to the ticket. thanks all! :heart: 

ops-bot: If this becomes an incident, run `ops create --template request-id-investigation --arg request_id=req_9f4b2e` to open a postmortem stub.
